The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move. | H1 2026 operating expenses and EPS filled 2026-11-07 from the Zenith Bank Plc interim report for the six months ended 30 June 2026 on the NGX filing library (operating expenses 451,327 plus personnel 138,451 plus depreciation 35,423 plus amortisation 8,557 = 633,758 N million, the total-cost basis the FY2024 column matches; basic and diluted EPS 10.48). FY2025 and FY2024 EPS were stored as 0.00 with no verified source and are now blank. | CRON 2026-11-10: EPS FY2025 25.32 and FY2024 32.87 naira, the printed 'Basic and diluted earnings per share (Naira)', Group column, Zenith Bank Plc Annual Report 31 December 2025 pages 4 and 110; both cells had been left empty. Profit Before Tax FY2025 set to the printed 1,263,370 million naira and Net Profit FY2025 to the printed profit for the year 1,040,546 million, replacing rounded 1,260,000 and 1,041,000 million values that broke the printed identity. Ties: 1,263,370 less income tax 222,824 equals 1,040,546 exactly. | CRON 2026-11-10: FY2024 to FY2021 profit before taxation replaced with the audited five-year financial summary (Zenith Bank Plc Annual Report 31 December 2025, page 284, Group columns, millions of naira): 1,326,851 / 795,962 / 284,650 / 280,374. Income tax for those four years is now stored positive like FY2025 and H1 2026, the charge positive and a credit negative, so Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit in every period. Printed EPS in kobo 2,532 / 3,287 / 2,155 / 714 / 778 confirms 25.32 / 32.87 / 21.55 / 7.14 / 7.78 naira.
